title: BC Friday Tips #87 Check for Microsoft Apps on AppSource
summary: Not all Microsoft applications for Business Central are installed by default. Before requesting customizations, check AppSource for available Microsoft apps that may provide the needed functionality, such as External Storage for document attachments.
key_points: Microsoft apps for Business Central are distributed across multiple separate applications on AppSource
Essential features like external document storage require installing dedicated Microsoft apps
Consultants should verify available Microsoft apps on AppSource before recommending custom development
Business Central functionality extends beyond the core product through optional Microsoft apps

quotes.text: not all Microsoft apps are installed in your Business Central environment by default
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why expected features may not be available without additional installation steps

quotes.text: Check what's available before assuming you need a customisation
quotes.why_it_matters: Directs consultants to reduce unnecessary custom development by exploring standard Microsoft solutions first
